class.name: HTMLListenerHandle
class.brief_description: A cancellable registration returned by [method HTMLEventTarget.listen].
class.description: The handle retains the event target and callback until [method cancel] is called or the target becomes invalid.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Removes the listener. Calling this more than once has no additional effect.

members.member: Whether [method cancel] has been called on this handle.
